decision_rule.fail: Reject composition of generated QK with sparse MoE; retain the dense-complete-expert MoE and standalone QK-only controls. Do not sweep QK capacity or modify experts.
decision_rule.pass: Authorize exactly one 124M 5TPP confirmation of the same composition. Generated experts and larger rungs remain blocked.

monitoring.performance_preflight: foreground-polled because it must finish within five minutes

scientific_question: Does the already validated generated-QK score map compose with the independently validated dense-complete-expert MoE without destroying its loss advantage, when every residual-write matrix and both matrices of each complete expert remain dense?

theory.claim_boundary: A pass validates composition of one attention read-map compression with dense sparse experts. It does not compress experts, inference parameters, expert FLOPs, V/O, or c_proj, and is not full replacement.
theory.evidence_reconciliation: Mapped QK beat the matched dense 124M transformer at 5TPP, whereas compact V/O and c_proj mappings repeatedly failed. Dense complete-expert MoE beat the matched dense transformer at 0.5TPP and 20TPP and replicated across seeds. The candidate composes only these two positive findings.
theory.why_cfc_stays_dense_here: The dense-transformer directed-product c_fc control closed terminal CE but realized zero algorithmic parameter reduction. Sparse expert c_fc has no tested batched generated implementation and no passed representability gate; adding one now would confound composition with a new expert mechanism.
theory.write_matrix_boundary: Attention V/O and expert c_proj remain full-state because heldout functional state budgets and the unrestricted shared-gauge MPO upper bound show that residual-write direction cannot be carried by the tested compact shared charts.
